meta.purpose: Defines accepted intake formats and the canonical normalized job schema every posting is converted into.

intake_methods.description: Paste a single job URL into a .txt file in /job_posts or into the intake prompt.
intake_methods.how: Save as job_posts/<name>.txt with the URL on the first line.

intake_methods.description: Copy the full job description text from any board or career page.
intake_methods.how: Save the raw text as job_posts/<name>.txt. The intake script parses it.

intake_methods.description: Export/download saved jobs as CSV from LinkedIn, Indeed, or ZipRecruiter.
intake_methods.how: Drop the CSV into /job_posts. Run scripts/intake.py --csv <file>.

intake_methods.description: Excerpt from a company career page.
intake_methods.how: Same as paste_description; tag the company in the filename.

normalized_job_schema.work_mode: one of: Remote | Hybrid | On-site | Unknown
normalized_job_schema.scam_risk: one of: Low | Medium | High | Reject
normalized_job_schema.recommendation: one of: Apply immediately | Strong match | Possible match | Weak match | Do not apply
normalized_job_schema.decision: one of: Apply | Do Not Apply
